source_notes: Keep the fall log on a BMS trip. (1) APPROVED (Atlas): logger on its own thread with a ring buffer, fsync every 100 ms, never fsync in the 50 Hz loop. (2) APPROVED WITH CHANGES (Atlas): an overcurrent trip gives no advance warning, so sensing only helps with item 3; use a comparator/supervisor with a set trip point wired to a Pi GPIO interrupt, input clamped to <=3.3 V at 8.4 V pack. Candidate: the power-fail comparator inside LTC3226 (PFO to GPIO, pulled up to 3.3 V). (3) PROPOSED, conditional: 2x Maxwell BCAP0010P270S01 (10 F 2.7 V, 30 mOhm per DigiKey) in series = 5 F, ~60 mOhm, balanced and charged by ADI LTC3226 (2-cell supercap charger + backup PowerPath, backup LDO up to 2 A peak). Rejected: 1 F coin EDLC (3.5-35 Ohm), Eaton PB-5R0V105-R (500 mOhm @100 Hz). Rail split: SG90s and MAX98357A amp currently take 5 V from Pi header (same net as Pi) - move them to the UBEC output upstream of the backup path so only the Pi is held up. Compute = Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W (upstream BOM sheet row 15). Draw (CNX Software Otii measurement): ~120 mA idle, 624 mA peak multi-core benchmark, 1.35-1.46 A peak with USB HDD+CPU+GPU stress; design worst case 1.5 A (7.5 W, Woz estimate incl. WiFi+camera). Hold-up estimate (Woz, unmeasured): caps 5.3->4.9 V usable ~10 J, ~1.3 s at 7.5 W; ESR drop ~0.09 V at 1.5 A. LTC3226 charge current, cap charge time and cell size/weight still to verify.
